requirements:
# Material Proportioning Process Control - **Difficulty:** Hard (hard) ## Requirements Design a PLC program to control a material proportioning process that requires mixing three types of materials according to specific requirements and then delivering them to the next process through valve D. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operation modes and be able to safely stop all equipment when an emergency stop signal is triggered. Control requirements: Emergency Stop Logic: The estop(=FALSE) signal is used for emergency stopping of all equipment. Manual Mode: opeMode=false, manually control the start/stop of valves A, B, C, D, and the mixing motor. Automatic Mode: opeMode=true, equipment operates automatically according to the process flow. Implement the emergency stop logic to ensure that all equipment stops immediately when the emergency stop signal is triggered. In manual mode, manually control the start/stop of valves and the mixing motor. For example, pressing the valve A start button valveAStart (triggering a rising edge) causes valve A to run (valveARun=TRUE); pressing the valve A start button valveAStart again (triggering a rising edge) stops valve A (valveARun=FALSE). In automatic mode, implement the following control logic based on the process flow: Press the autoStart button to start the automatic process, first opening valve A. When the liquid level sensor levelSensor reaches 50cm, close valve A and open valve B. When the liquid level sensor reaches 80cm, close valve B. Based on processMode: If processMode=false, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends. If processMode=true, open valve C; when the liquid level sensor reaches 100cm, close valve C, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends. ## Interface Definition | Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Input | `estop` | `BOOL` | Emergency Stop Signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered | | Input | `opeMode` | `BOOL` | Operation Mode
FALSE: Manual Operation Mode
TRUE: Automatic Operation Mode | | Input | `valveAStart` | `BOOL` | Valve A Start Button | | Input | `valveBStart` | `BOOL` | Valve B Start Button | | Input | `valveCStart` | `BOOL` | Valve C Start Button | | Input | `valveDStart` | `BOOL` | Valve D Start Button | | Input | `mixMotorStart` | `BOOL` | Mixing Motor Start Button | | Input | `autoStart` | `BOOL` | Automatic Start Button | | Input | `processMode` | `BOOL` | Process Mode | | Input | `levelSensor` | `INT` | Liquid Level Sensor (unit cm) | | Input | `mixMotorComplete` | `BOOL` | Mixing Complete Signal | | Output | `valveARun` | `BOOL` | Valve A Run Command | | Output | `valveBRun` | `BOOL` | Valve B Run Command | | Output | `valveCRun` | `BOOL` | Valve C Run Command | | Output | `valveDRun` | `BOOL` | Valve D Run Command | | Output | `mixMotorRun` | `BOOL` | Mixing Motor Run Command |

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: estop=FALSE turns every actuator off immediately.
Automatic phases drive only one actuator; independent manual toggles may coexist.
assumptions: All manual buttons use rising-edge independent toggles. Edge history updates during emergency stop so held buttons cannot restart outputs on recovery.
Emergency stop resets all manual latches and automatic state. A fresh autoStart edge is required to restart.
Changing operation mode clears old latches and sequence.
autoStart is a rising edge accepted in IDLE or DRAIN to start a fresh batch from FILL_A; processMode stays latched for the active batch (phases 1..5).
Thresholds are >=50, >=80 and >=100 cm. One logical phase transition occurs per invocation.
In DRAIN, valveDRun remains TRUE until emergency stop (estop=FALSE), mode switch to manual (opeMode=FALSE), or a fresh autoStart rising edge starting a new batch.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

V2 mode-change priority: emergency stop first; then a change of mode after the first invocation clears sequence/latches and suppresses commands for that invocation; edge memories still update. The first invocation establishes the selected mode and executes normally. New commands are accepted on subsequent invocations subject to their edge rules.

atomic_propositions.toggle: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND NOT opeMode AND rising(valveAStart))
atomic_propositions.held: safe AND NOT opeMode AND NOT rising(valveAStart) AND no mode change
atomic_propositions.toB: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_A AND levelSensor>=50)
atomic_propositions.toMix: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND NOT latched_batch_mode)
atomic_propositions.toC: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND latched_batch_mode)
atomic_propositions.fromC: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_C AND levelSensor>=100)
atomic_propositions.mixed: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase MIX AND mixMotorComplete)

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).

ltl.name: Emergency
ltl.explanation: Emergency permissive dominates mode and buttons.

ltl.name: Manual toggle
ltl.explanation: A held button cannot repeatedly toggle; applies independently to all five buttons.

ltl.name: First fill threshold
ltl.explanation: A closes and B opens at or above 50cm.

ltl.name: Mix completion
ltl.explanation: Mix completion stops mixing and opens D.

ltl.description: In Manual mode without E-stop or mode change, each of the five manual outputs toggles independently on its button rising edge and holds when held/released.
ltl.explanation: Extends P2 manual coverage from valveA to all five actuators (A, B, C, D, Mix).

ltl.description: Automatic mode turns on at most one actuator at any scan, and any mode switch clears all actuators on the switching scan.
ltl.explanation: Guarantees single-actuator automatic progression and mode-change isolation.

transition.reference_binding: Persistent plc_agent.scan_contract.ScanContract('PUB015'); constructed once per independent case, current state is Sref[k].

comparison.integer_boolean: exact type and value; no tolerance
comparison.float: finite; abs error<=1e-5; dictionary/list shape and non-float values exact
comparison.PUB008: only successfully converted channels[j].outputValue: abs<=1e-5 OR rel<=2e-6; all preserved/config fields exact
comparison.PUB017: Successful deletion constrains recipeID=0; other fields of that deleted slot are unconstrained for the deletion scan. Subsequent no-write scans preserve the sampled actual representation. This observer history is separate from the logical reference database.
comparison.TIME_LTIME: exact integer nanoseconds after IEC literal parsing
comparison.implementation: plc_agent.normalized_spec.NormalizedScanMonitor.step with output_matches (pinned sources); observer histories never drive the independent logical reference

observation.I[k]: deep-copied inputs immediately before invocation k
observation.O[k]: actual outputs immediately after invocation k, supplied by independent execution backend
observation.Sref[k]: independent reference state BEFORE k; unrelated to similarly named candidate variables
observation.initial: fresh instance BEFORE invocation 0; never substituted by O[0]
observation.X: next scan-sequence position; argument must be Boolean, not a numeric term
observation.time: dt_ms is observed elapsed time; public timers use physical time, SELF Tick/count timers use logical scans

auxiliary_state_bindings.Spre: Sref[k], before the invocation; initialized by reference_state_initial
auxiliary_state_bindings.Spost: Sref[k+1], after exactly one pinned transition on I[k]
auxiliary_state_bindings.first: k=0 (first invocation); distinct from the pre-invocation initial observation
auxiliary_state_bindings.pre-output: actual O[k-1] for OUTPUT (explicit history initial where declared); I[k] for caller-owned IN_OUT
auxiliary_state_bindings.previous-input: I[k-1] for k>=1; edge memory for BOOL requests initially FALSE and updated after EVERY invocation
auxiliary_state_bindings.reference_warning: Spre/Spost predicates are input-driven ghosts, not evidence that candidate internals match. Conclusions about the candidate must constrain actual O.
auxiliary_state_bindings.modeChanged: Spre.process_contract.mode is not None AND Spre.process_contract.mode != I[k].opeMode

normalized_specification.reference_state_rule: Initial state is the serialized constructor above; all fields update solely through the pinned transition. Ghost phase/history/queue are names for this state, not observed candidate state.

primitives.bitwise: DWORD AND/NOT and popcount operate on unsigned 32-bit values; complement is masked by 0xFFFFFFFF.
primitives.time_literals: IEC TIME/LTIME literals are exact integer durations in nanoseconds.
primitives.observed_arrays: All IN_OUT inputs are snapshots before invocation; outputs are independently acquired after invocation. Physical bounds map by ordinal, never share another array lower bound.
primitives.boolean_next: X takes a Boolean formula. Numeric history transport is bit-expanded for DWORD; Boolean histories use equivalence.
primitives.time_progress: Timed eventuality clauses explicitly require G(F(TimeTick)); TimeTick denotes crossing a new integer-ms boundary. Finite observations cannot establish this premise.
